# tplinkeasysmart_qos (Data Source)

QoS basic settings (QoS > QoS Basic). Read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplinkeasysmart_qos" "this" {}

output "qos_mode" {
  value = data.tplinkeasysmart_qos.this.mode
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `switch` (String) Name of the switch (a key of the provider's `switches` map) this object lives on. Required when the provider has a `switches` map; `default` is the provider's own switch (`host`) beside it. Omit it when the provider has only its own switch.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `qos`.
- `mode` (String) `port-based`, `802.1p` or `dscp-802.1p`, as the `tplinkeasysmart_qos` resource spells it.
- `port_priorities` (Attributes List) Priority queue per port, 1 (lowest) to 4 (highest) as in the web UI. Only effective in port-based mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--port_priorities))

<a id="nestedatt--port_priorities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `port_priorities`

Read-Only:

- `port` (Number) Port number.
- `priority` (Number) Priority queue, 1 (lowest) to 4 (highest).
